## STREAM 3 — TWO NEW DATED ENTRIES SINCE THE 08-24 CAPTURE
## NOTE: the 08-24 scan recorded this stream as topping at Aug 20. It now carries Aug 21 and Aug 24.
## => TREAT THIS STREAM AS CAPABLE OF BACK-FILLING DATES; do not trust "tops at X" as final.

### August 24, 2026
- **D&B Commercial Graph data store (Preview)** — search and import company data using natural
  language. REPORTED MED/AISPM (bundled with the Aug 21 data stores).
- **Cloud Monitoring telemetry for data connectors extended.** REPORTED MED/AIDR.
    discoveryengine.googleapis.com/dataconnector/request_count
      + NEW dimensions: **tool_id** (identifier of the connector tool invoked),
                        **engine_id** (the Gemini Enterprise app identifier),
                        **response_code** (gRPC response status)
      (existing `status` dimension retained)
    NEW metric (Beta):
      discoveryengine.googleapis.com/dataconnector/**request_latencies**
      "distribution of tool invocation latency" in ms; dimensions status, response_code,
      tool_id, engine_id.
  KEY CAVEATS: these are METRICS, not logs — dimensions/counts/distributions only, NO arguments,
  NO results, NO invoking-user identity. Correlating to a principal still needs audit logs + traces.
  Metrics publish under the `discoveryengine.googleapis.com/` prefix = Google's "all other Google
  Cloud metrics" tier = **RETAINED SIX WEEKS BY DEFAULT** (~42 days). request_latencies is Beta so
  its dimension set may still change.
  Doc: docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/access-metrics

### August 21, 2026
- **Seven new data stores (Public Preview)**: **Atlan** (data catalog / governance metadata),
  **Bitly**, **FactSet AI-Ready Data** (licensed financial data), **FullStory** (session replay +
  product analytics = recorded user behaviour), **Globalping**, **Pendo**, **Stripe** (payments).
  Searchable and readable with natural language. REPORTED MED/AISPM.
- **New ACTIONS on existing connectors (Public Preview)** — *** THESE ARE NOT READS ***:
    **Supabase**: apply migration | deploy edge function | **execute SQL** | pause project |
                  restore project
                  => an agent holding these OPERATES Supabase, it does not ground on it.
                     `deploy edge function` = CODE DEPLOYMENT driven by an agent.
                     `pause/restore project` = availability operations.
    **Descript**: import media | prompt project agent | publish project  (publish = external sink)
    **Gamma**:    generate Gamma
  Doc: docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/connectors/supabase
  DEPLOYMENT CONSTRAINTS: Google recommends associating only ONE data store with actions belonging to
  a SINGLE connector type per app. The Supabase data store is supported only in `global`, `us`, `eu`.
- AI Developer Tools available on the **Standard Emerging Market edition** for projects on invoiced
  Cloud Billing accounts. Entitlement change — HELD below the bar.

## CARRIED FORWARD (reported earlier, unchanged)
- Aug 20: Antigravity for IDEs — reported 2026-08-21.
- Aug 20: Okta SCIM autocomplete; Google Identity for third-party data stores — explicitly held 08-21.
- Aug 7: custom MCP server data stores GA (off by default behind an org-policy constraint; auth = none
  OR OAuth 2.0; HTTPS + StreamableHTTP; importable from the Agent Registry) — reported 2026-08-09.
- Aug 6: automatic tools/list tool discovery. Aug 4: execute_tool / invoke_connector trace spans.
  Aug 3: 17 third-party connectors (iManage, NetDocuments, Cohesity, Supabase, Oracle NetSuite).
- **Agent Identity (SPIFFE)** — reported 2026-08-24 from /iam/docs/agent-identity-overview.
